$comment: G6-5 (APR-JE-046): the ordered checks of the base engineering. verify.mjs, the cross-browser runner and the verification record's expected check list are all read from this file, the industry adapter's descriptor and the project manifest: a check is added by adding an entry, never by editing the runner. Each entry: tier (fast = also in verify --fast), scope (static: no browser, run once; engine: browser-driven, run in every engine; chromium-only: cannot run elsewhere, with the reason), needs (project capabilities the check requires; an unmet need is reported as not applicable, never skipped silently), selftest (skipped by --no-selftest). Text may use {baseline} for the project's baseline label. Checks of a restaurant project and of one project come from the industry adapter and the project manifest and are merged in after the anchor they name.
